title: Dramatic impact of auxiliary ligands on the two-step magnetic relaxation process in Dy(III) single-molecule magnets

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, a mixture of H2L (0.2 mmol, 48.6 mg) and triethylamine (0.4 mmol, 0.06 ml) in acetonitrile (5 ml) was stirred for 10 min. Solid Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol, 131.6 mg) was added and stirred for 20 min. After a further 30 min stirring, a DMF (5 ml) solution of 1-phenylbutane-1,3-dione (PhacacH, 0.2 mmol, 32.4 mg) and triethylamine (0.2 mmol, 0.03 ml) was added and stirred for 30 min. The solution was filtered and the filtrate stood at room temperature for three days. Yellow block crystals formed by slow evaporation and were collected by filtration (57% yield based on Dy).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction under aerobic conditions; filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate allowed to stand at room temperature for three days; yellow block crystals by slow evaporation, collected by filtration

properties.summary: Dy4 SMM with two-step relaxation. Room-temperature χMT = 57.24 cm3 K mol−1 (500 Oe). Magnetization 22.4 Nβ at 2 K and 7 T without saturation; no obvious hysteresis at 1.8 K. Frequency-dependent χM″ below 22 K under zero dc field. Fast (low-T, Dy2) barrier 14 K (τ0 = 4.14×10−7 s); slow (high-T, Dy1) Ueff/kB = 58 K (τ0 = 9.61×10−6 s) with Raman+Orbach fit.

measurements.conditions: room temperature, 500 Oe, 1.8–300 K dc data

measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Raman+Orbach fit, τ0 = 9.61×10−6 s, C = 2.5 s−1 K−2.1, n = 2.1

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to complex 1 under aerobic conditions, replacing 1-phenylbutane-1,3-dione with 2-acetylcyclopentanone (ACP, 0.2 mmol, 0.03 ml). Yellow block crystals formed by slow evaporation over two days and were collected by filtration (64% yield based on Dy). Shared procedure of 1: H2L (0.2 mmol, 48.6 mg) and NEt3 (0.4 mmol, 0.06 ml) in MeCN (5 ml), then Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol, 131.6 mg), then DMF (5 ml) with auxiliary ligand and additional NEt3 (0.2 mmol, 0.03 ml).

reagents.amount: 0.4 mmol, 0.06 ml then 0.2 mmol, 0.03 ml (as for 1)

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow block crystals by slow evaporation for two days, collected by filtration
